name: Endometrial Stromal Sarcoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Female Reproductive Organs

criteria.description: Presence of uniform small cells resembling proliferative-phase endometrial stromal cells with infiltrative growth pattern
Positive staining for CD10, estrogen receptor (ER), and progesterone receptor (PR)
Detection of JAZF1-SUZ12 gene fusion or other characteristic chromosomal translocations
Presentation with abnormal uterine bleeding or pelvic mass

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with supportive immunohistochemical and/or molecular genetic findings
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Differentiation from other uterine sarcomas and benign stromal nodules is critical

pathognomonic.symptomName: Pelvic mass detected on examination or imaging
searchTerms: pelvic lump found on exam or scan

common.symptomName: Fatigue related to chronic blood loss

occasional.symptomName: Urinary frequency or urgency due to mass effect
searchTerms: frequent or urgent urination from mass
urinary symptoms due to pelvic growth

occasional.symptomName: Leg edema from pelvic venous obstruction
searchTerms: leg swelling from blocked pelvic veins
lower limb edema due to pelvic vein obstruction
swollen legs from pelvic blood flow issues

rare.symptomName: Pulmonary symptoms from metastatic disease (e.g., dyspnea, cough)
searchTerms: breathing difficulty and cough from metastases
pulmonary problems due to cancer spread
elevated calcium levels due to paraneoplastic syndrome
numbness or weakness from brain metastases
neurological symptoms due to brain cancer spread

laboratory: Anemia due to chronic blood loss
Elevated serum calcium in rare paraneoplastic cases
imaging: Pelvic ultrasound showing heterogeneous uterine mass
MRI demonstrating infiltrative myometrial lesion with low T1 and high T2 signal
other: Histopathology showing small uniform cells with infiltrative pattern
Immunohistochemistry positive for CD10, ER, PR

distinguishingFeatures: Spindle cell morphology with marked atypia

redFlags: Evidence of distant metastases on imaging
references: WHO Classification of Tumors of Female Reproductive Organs, 5th Edition, 2020
Am J Surg Pathol. 2014;38(7):e60-e72. Endometrial stromal sarcomas: molecular and histopathologic features
Orphanet Report Series: Endometrial stromal sarcoma, ORPHA:213711
